aim:
The full news archive page: headline, optional subtitle, a list of items, and a footer
reporting how many items are shown and when the feed was last updated. 9 active placements
/ 8 sites at authoring time. The items are server-rendered AND then replaced client-side
from `/data/news-archive.json`; the server copy is a deliberate fallback (bugs_open/027) so
an empty or failing feed leaves a readable page rather than a blank one.
contract: - Root `section.news-listing-section[data-component="news-listing"]`.
- `{{.headline}}` is unconditional -> `.news-listing-title` must carry text. `{{.subheadline}}`
is conditional and is NOT asserted.
- `{{range .items}}` -> at least one `article.news-list-item` inside `.news-listing-items`.
- **The interactive half.** `/tools/assets/news-listing.js` fetches `/data/news-archive.json`,
rewrites the items, un-hides `#news-listing-footer` (server-rendered `style="display:none"`)
and writes `#news-listing-count`. The fence asserts that count reads `\d+ item`, which is
reachable ONLY if the client-side feed load completed -- it is the one assertion here that
a static render cannot satisfy. `#news-listing-count` is read with InnerText, so a hidden
footer reads empty and the check fails, which is the intended discrimination.
- Consequence to know before re-pointing this fence: on a proof page whose feed is
deliberately EMPTY the designed behaviour is a placeholder and a hidden footer, so this
check would fail correctly-but-uselessly. Point it at a placement whose feed serves.
proof_note: Single-instance placement; 21 assets and CSS url() backgrounds probed, all 200; `/data/news-archive.json` serves 200.
mutants: 8/8 caught, every check watched red, baseline green
accommodations: serve_local `/data/news-archive.json` -- the page's own same-origin fetch, which the redirect harness would turn cross-origin and CORS would kill

aim:
The homepage news teaser: heading, a card grid of recent items, and a "More insights" link
the feed supplies. 6 active placements / 6 sites at authoring time. Like `news-listing` its
items are server-rendered and then replaced from `/data/latest-news.json`.
contract: - Root `section.latest-news-section[data-component="latest-news"]`.
- `h2#news-headline` is unconditional AND is the slot the feed overwrites -- asserted for text
by its id, not by position, because the id is what the script writes into.
`#news-subheadline` is conditional and is NOT asserted.
- `{{range .items}}` -> at least one `article.news-card` inside `.news-grid`.
- **The interactive half.** `/tools/assets/latest-news.js` fetches `/data/latest-news.json` and,
when the feed carries `insights_url`, fills the server-rendered EMPTY `<div id="news-footer">`
with `a.news-more-link`. That anchor exists in no server render, so asserting it is a direct
assertion that the client-side feed load completed.
proof_note: Single-instance placement; 30 assets probed, all 200; `/data/latest-news.json` serves 200 with 6 items and an `insights_url`.
mutants: 8/8 caught, every check watched red, baseline green
accommodations: serve_local `/data/latest-news.json` -- same reason as `news-listing` (this exact path is the measured precedent recorded in the prover's own header)

aim:
The case-studies index with a category filter bar: eyebrow, headline, intro, five filter
buttons, and a grid of fixed cards each tagged with a `data-category`. 4 active placements /
3 sites at authoring time.
contract: - Root `section.case-studies-grid-section[data-component="case-studies-grid"]`.
- `.csg-headline` is unconditional -> must carry text.
- At least one `article.csg-card` inside `.csg-grid`.
- **The interactive half.** `/tools/assets/case-studies-grid.js` binds a click on every
`.csg-filter-btn`: the clicked button gains `.active` AND `aria-current="true"`, the others
lose both, and cards whose `data-category` does not match are hidden. The fence dispatches
the visitor's REAL click on the `strategy` filter and asserts
`.csg-filter-btn[data-filter="strategy"].active[aria-current="true"]`. No server render
carries `aria-current` at all (grep of the served proof page: 0 occurrences), so this can
only pass if the handler ran.
mutants: 8/8 caught, every check watched red, baseline green
notes: **A defect found by choosing the proof page, recorded here rather than fixed.**
`finetuning.uk/index.html` carries this component and 404s FIVE of its card images:
That is the same detected-but-never-repaired class as the `hero.jpg` family
(`bugs_closed/128`), and it is why the proof placement is leopardess rather than finetuning.

aim:
The contact section: enquiry details (email, phone, location, response-time badge) beside a
validated enquiry form. 3 active placements / 3 sites at authoring time.
contract: - Root `section.contact-block-section[data-component="contact-block"]`.
- `.cb-heading` is unconditional -> must carry text.
- `form.cb-form` present.
- **The interactive half, and the deliberate limit of it.** `/tools/assets/contact-block.js`
binds submit, calls `preventDefault()`, and runs four client-side validations. The fence
clicks submit on an EMPTY form and asserts `#cb-status.cb-error` carries text -- an invalid
submission must come back with a reason. That is real behaviour and it is mutation-proven.
- **What this fence deliberately does NOT assert: the success message.** The component prints
"Your message has been sent. We'll be in touch shortly." from a 1,200 ms `setTimeout`, and
the component contains NO transport whatsoever -- no `action` on the form, and zero
`fetch(`/`XMLHttpRequest`/`sendBeacon` in the served 2,100-byte asset. Asserting that message
would make this contract vouch for a claim that is false to the visitor. Filed as
`bugs_open/228`; when it is fixed, the right addition here is a check that the success state
is downstream of a RESPONSE, not of a timer.
mutants: 8/8 caught, every check watched red, baseline green

aim:
The blog index with a category filter bar: eyebrow, heading, intro, four filter buttons and a
grid of post cards. 2 placement rows at authoring time, of which ONE renders (see Notes).
contract: - Root `section.blog-listing-section[data-component="blog-listing"]`.
- `.bl-heading` is unconditional -> must carry text.
- At least one `article.bl-card` inside `.bl-grid`.
- **The interactive half.** `/tools/assets/blog-listing.js` binds a click on every
`.bl-filter-btn`; the clicked button gains `.active` and the others lose it. Unlike its
sibling `case-studies-grid` it sets NO `aria-current`, so the assertion is on `.active`
alone -- and the fence clicks `cat1`, never `all`, because `all` carries `.active` in the
server render and asserting it would pass with the script deleted.
mutants: 8/8 caught, every check watched red, baseline green
notes: **Placement drift, recorded not fixed.** The other placement row,
`leopardessconsulting.co.uk/blog.html`, points at a page whose served HTML contains NO
`data-component` attribute at all -- not this component's, not any component's. The row
is effectively unplaced. Same class as the `featured-content` / `pricing` / `ported-page`
rows recorded in this lane's NOTES on 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-08.
